description:
[EU cross-border triangular transaction auditor. Statutory audit, read-only, side-effect free]. Audits simplified triangular trade transactions under Article 141 of Council Directive 2006/112/EC involving three distinct Member States, generating mandatory invoice notations, verifying VAT shift to final customer (Art. 197), and determining Intrastat obligations.
Usage: Use this tool when Company B buys goods from Company A and sells to Company C with direct transport from A to C.
Returns: JSON object with { isArticle141SimplificationEligible: boolean, memberStatesInvolved: object, mandatoryInvoiceStatementPartyBToC: string, vatLiabilityTransferredToPartyC: boolean, partyB_VatRegistrationInCountryCRequired: boolean, intrastatReportingGuidelines: object }.

goodsShippedDirectlyFromAToC.description: True if physical transport of goods occurred directly from Member State A to Member State C without entering Country B

invoiceLanguage.description: Language for the statutory invoice notation (default: EN)

netTransactionAmountEur.description: Total net transaction amount in EUR

countryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of original supplier (e.g. IT)
2-letter ISO country code of intermediary buyer (e.g. FR)

partyC_FinalCustomer.description: Party C: Final recipient in destination country

countryIso2.description: 2-letter ISO country code of final destination customer (e.g. DE)

name: vat_triangulation_audit
